scope: Canonical names shared by more than one cedar_uid in data/spine/cedar_identity_register.csv, pending owner adjudication. An entry records that the pair is known and under review, so server/tests/test_public_preview_audit.py and Lumecon-data's `lumecon-data spine check --allowlist` report it as a review item instead of a failure. An entry never merges, renames, retires or re-mints an identity; only the owner's adjudication, written into the register itself, closes it, and the entry is then removed (a stale entry fails the audit). Same shape as Lumecon-data intake/spine-duplicate-name-review.json.
